description: This script identifies violations related to 'firecrawl'-specific fetch logic within a codebase, scanning through project files excluding some predefined allowed files and directories.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Recursively traverses the directory tree starting from a root directory, accumulating paths of files matching specific extensions.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a full file path into a normalized, repository-relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans project files for lines containing 'firecrawl' or 'Firecrawl' that match suspicious patterns, reporting potential boundary violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinate function that runs the violation detection process and outputs results in JSON or text format.
